title: Cuttwood Bar Salts Peach Mango Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cuttwood Nic Salt Peach Mango Ice offers a sun-soaked blend of juicy peach and sweet mango flavours with a cool, icy finish. This e-liquid combines the vibrant flavours of ripe peaches and mangoes with a refreshing menthol twist, creating a smooth and satisfying vape experience. Ideal for vapers who enjoy summer fruit flavours with an icy touch. Cuttwood Nic Salt e-liquids are crafted with a balanced 50VG/50PG mix, making them perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping devices and pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, offering an effective alternative for adult smokers and vapers. Hailing from the USA, Cuttwood are renowned for their high-quality e-liquids and distinctive flavour profiles. Their dedication to excellence has earned them a loyal following among vapers worldwide. Now available in the UK, Cuttwood Nic Salts bring their premium flavours to a broader audience in the form of nicotine salt vape liquids, ideal for use with various MTL vape devices.
